newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee co-op stocks total 3.68 bags in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee co-op stocks total 3.68 bags in Nov.

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian co-operatives totalled 3.68 million 60.5 kg bags on November 30, the National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.

This is down from than the 4.10 million bags held by co-operatives as of October 31 but up from the 3.05 million bags held at the same stage last year when producers were bringing in the frost and drought-hit 1995/96 harvest.
It is however well below the 5.20 million bags in stock by the end of November 1994.

Co-operatives received 307,710 bags of coffee during the month of November, well over twice the 128,582 bags delivered in November last year but below the 337,354 bags received in November two years ago.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
